description: Report-only legal review of the complete current delta and its direct legal and documentary effects.

items.text: Are your findings grounded in the applicable law, case record and intended use of the changed material, rather than an unsupported preference or an audit of the whole matter? State the standard used.

Did you review the complete delta and its direct legal effects without reopening unrelated settled work? Identify any cross-reference, conclusion or deadline directly affected and any proposed expansion removed.

For the delta and its direct effects, which decisive references did you contrast online with reliable primary or official sources? Explain how you checked identity, exact provision or holding, date and current or historically applicable version, legal weight and applicability. Identify any supplied reference that failed or remains unverified and the resulting limit; if none, say so; never imply that an inaccessible source was checked.

For the delta and its direct effects, what is the strongest applicable authority or plausible legal interpretation against the proposed position? Explain the facts and reasoning that support or weaken it, distinguishing binding authority, persuasive material, party preference and your own judgment.

Which missing or disputed facts, jurisdiction, relevant date, procedural stage or deadline could change the delta and its direct effects? State what the record establishes, what must be asked or verified and whether a conditional answer is possible. Do not manufacture facts or ask immaterial questions.

intro: QUESTIONS (answer each with concise case-document or verified legal evidence; these are investigation checks, not a separate legal opinion. Put material limitations and decision-changing questions in the deliverable.)

text: TASK: incremental legal review of the CURRENT WORK TREE against base revision {{delta_base_revision}} — every committed, staged, unstaged and newly created change after that base — plus its direct effects. HEAD is not the baseline.

REPORT ONLY. Read surrounding clauses, facts and authorities where the delta changes meaning, legal effect, a deadline, a citation or a conclusion. Do not reopen an unrestricted audit of unchanged material.

BASELINE: the current reviewed skeleton at {{skeleton_path}} defines the assignment within the MANDATE. The original mandate remains at {{goal_path}} for unsettled intent; neither is authority for facts or law.

STANDARD: {{reference_path}} — check the delta against the reviewed brief and applicable legal and documentary basis. A private permission or earlier approval cannot excuse a legal defect in the change.
